issues.where: crop C, bright face of the disk
issues.what: granulation is soft and low-contrast, and the hottest patches flatten to a smooth yellow-white with smeared cells. The same face is in image-03 crop M
issues.fix: hold detail in the highlights and sharpen the granule edges so the surface is not airbrushed

issues.where: upper-right limb and the prominences along the lower edge
issues.what: the loops and radial shafts are cloudy and plastic, and the disk edge is a fuzzy blown glow with no filament structure. The same edge is in image-02 crops A, E, H and I, and image-03 crops L, Q and R
issues.fix: break the loops into thin filaments and keep a defined limb under the glow

issues.where: a few of the brightest stars
issues.what: saturated stars bloom into small round skirts instead of tight points. The rest of the starfield crops hold up
issues.fix: tighten the brightest stars so they stay pinpoints with only a small glow

issues.where: crop W, lower-right ochre dust in the judged frame
issues.what: The brightest parts of the dust resolve into soft, rounded patches. The fine star speckle stays sharp over them, making the diffuse structure look slightly airbrushed by comparison.
issues.fix: Add subtle filament detail and vary the edge softness of the dust while keeping its broad glow.

issues.where: crop V, bright white star near the left edge
issues.what: The star has a conspicuously broad round glow compared with its tiny core and the surrounding pinpoints.
issues.fix: Tighten the bright-star glow and taper it more gradually so the core stays distinct without looking like a soft blob.

issues.where: asteroid, lit lower-left face (crops C, F, H, P)
issues.what: the surface detail is a uniform, evenly sized grain with many small craters of the same size; it reads as procedural noise rather than regolith, boulders and a range of crater sizes, and the dark upper-right half goes soft and a little airbrushed
issues.fix: add a range of crater sizes, a few boulders and ejecta, and stronger large-scale shape variation; raise detail and contrast in the shadowed half

issues.where: faint background stars across all sky crops
issues.what: the faintest stars are single hard-edged pixels, some saturated red, blue or orange, which look like colour noise or hot pixels at native size rather than point sources
issues.fix: draw faint stars as small soft PSFs at sub-pixel positions and tone down the colour saturation of the dimmest stars

issues.where: small star clumps (crop I lower right, R upper right, B centre)
issues.what: several tight clusters with the same look and density appear in the field and read as stamped copies
issues.fix: vary the size, density and brightness of the clusters, or place fewer of them

issues.where: upper centre to upper right sky (crops C, H, L)
issues.what: the faint bluish Milky Way glow is a smooth airbrushed haze with no dust lanes or structure
issues.fix: add mottled structure and dark lanes to the glow, or remove it

issues.where: crops A, B, C, F, G, H, and I (and matching Milky Way band in image-29.png and image-31.png crops J, K, L, M)
issues.what: the diffuse Milky Way cloud and dust-lane texture is visibly upscaled, soft, and blurry at native size while overlaid foreground stars are crisp 1-2 px points, exposing a two-layer sharp-dots-over-blurry-backdrop mismatch
issues.fix: use a higher-resolution galactic diffuse/extinction map (16K-32K) or add multi-scale filamentary dust detail and dense unresolved faint stars (mag 11-16) so the cloud backdrop matches native pixel sharpness at narrow FOV

issues.where: crop A upper right, crop F upper right and lower right, crop I lower left (and image-31.png crop L lower center and upper left)
issues.what: bright star clusters and galactic knots baked into the background map appear as smeared 15-40 px blurry glow blobs with only a few sharp foreground stars scattered over them
issues.fix: remove baked cluster blobs from the diffuse sky map and render those clusters as resolved individual stars across a continuous magnitude distribution

issues.where: crop O center and upper left (also visible in image-26.png crop H lower center and mid-left, crop D upper left, and image-25.png left Milky Way band)
issues.what: bright pink/magenta and blue-white objects render as soft 10-16 px circular Gaussian cotton-ball blobs with flat clipped white cores, especially the conspicuous twin pink blobs in crop O
issues.fix: replace wide uniform Gaussian glow stamps with compact stellar cores plus physically steep Airy/glare falloff, and use resolved nebula geometry rather than round pink radial blobs for HII regions

issues.where: crops B, C, and G (and isolated patches in image-26.png crop D center and crop H lower margin)
issues.what: peripheral Milky Way clouds and faint nebulae break into smooth, rounded 40-90 px airbrushed brown smudges with soft circular patch edges beneath sharp point stars
issues.fix: sculpt peripheral clouds with fine-scale dark dust filaments and resolve their edges into faint star density gradients instead of smooth airbrushed patches

issues.where: crops E, F, and G (and image-28.png crops U and V; plus upper-right dark sky across image-25.png and image-27.png crops K, L, M, Q, R)
issues.what: the Sagittarius bulge clouds in the wider frame still look slightly soft and airbrushed relative to the overlaid point stars, and a faint broad circular bluish skyglow patch is perceptible in the upper-right sky
issues.fix: increase fine dust and faint-star detail in the bulge map and even out the localized circular background glow in the upper-right sky

issues.what: the bands are smeared along latitude and look airbrushed, with no small-scale turbulence; the same smear is in image-35.png cell O and on the lit disk of image-33.png
issues.fix: break the latitudinal smear and add finer convective detail so the deck does not read as a painted texture

issues.where: cell S, thin outer ring arcs
issues.what: the high-contrast edges stair-step slightly against the sky; the same stepping shows on the outer arcs in image-33.png
issues.fix: antialias the thin ring edges so the arcs stay smooth
